errors.evidence: The agent states "On checking, the Wikipedia article quoted a figure in the 2020 estimate of slightly over 56,000 inhabitants. When rounding that number to the nearest thousand, it becomes 56,000." but does not provide any evidence of actually querying Wikipedia to obtain this information. It appears to have arrived at this answer without using the search tool.
errors.description: The agent claims to have found the population figure on Wikipedia but doesn't show any evidence of a web search or Wikipedia query. The answer is presented without verifiable source information.

scores.reliability_reasoning: The agent claims to use Wikipedia but provides no evidence of doing so. This raises concerns about the accuracy of the answer.
scores.instruction_adherence_reasoning: The agent did not follow the instruction to verify the information using the available tools and did not provide evidence of the information source.
scores.plan_opt_reasoning: The agent created a plan, but did not execute it correctly by finding the data from the source.
